categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Favored Nanotechnology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, and production of high-performance, multifunctional nano thin films and nano coating equipment. The company provides nano thin film products and coating services tailored to various industries including consumer electronics, automotive, medical devices, servers, and smart home products. It also sells self-developed nano coating equipment to customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), physical vapor deposition (PVD), atomic layer deposition (ALD), and other vacuum nano-coating technologies. It has proprietary nano coating equipment integrating multiple deposition technologies, enabling the production of multifunctional nano films with properties such as waterproofing, corrosion resistance, electrical insulation, and enhanced hardness. The company emphasizes automated control systems and AI-driven digital factory platforms to optimize production and R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading global technology companies in consumer electronics (smartphones, TWS earphones, wearable devices), automotive electronics (new energy vehicles, sensors, motor components), medical devices (hearing aids, portable monitors), servers and data centers, and smart home appliances. The company serves OEMs and EMS providers requiring high-reliability nano coating solutions for product protection and performance enhancement.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Wuxi and subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Wuhan. It also has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the USA, and Vietnam, supporting global market coverage including North America, Europe, and the Middle East. The company is expanding its international footprint and supply chain presence in emerging markets such as India, Malaysia, Pakistan, and Turkey.
categories.supply_chain_position: Favored Nanotechnology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of nano coating materials, nano thin film products, and coating equipment. It provides integrated coating services directly to downstream OEMs and EMS manufacturers, including onsite production support (resident production) and centralized coating services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in nano coating technologies, focusing on multifunctional films with enhanced protection, modification, and performance properties. It invests heavily in R&D (~18.7% of revenue), developing new equipment and materials, including environmentally friendly coatings compliant with global regulations. Strategic R&D directions include AI integration for digital factory transformation, advanced plasma technologies, and expanding applications in automotive electronics, medical devices, servers, and smart home sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of nano thin film products and related coating services, including onsite (resident) and centralized production models. Additionally, the company sells proprietary nano coating equipment to customers. The sales model is predominantly direct sales with a minor portion through distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Favored Nanotechnology is a leading player in the global nano coating industry with strong technological barriers and a comprehensive intellectual property portfolio. It holds a dominant position in China and is recognized internationally for its advanced plasma polymerization and vacuum coating technologies. The company competes with foreign brands but has achieved significant import substitution and industry upgrading in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 479.46 million, a 55.21% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 45.1 million. Total assets were about RMB 2.03 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company maintains a high gross margin (~53%) and continues to invest significantly in R&D and capacity expansion, demonstrating a strong growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly customized, multifunctional nano thin films with superior protective properties such as waterproofing, corrosion resistance, electrical insulation, and mechanical hardness. Its proprietary coating equipment and integrated solutions enable high-quality, efficient production tailored to complex application environments. The company emphasizes environmentally friendly materials, compliance with stringent global regulations, and AI-driven digital manufacturing, providing customers with innovative, reliable, and cost-effective nano coating solutions.
